domain.text: Software engineering: merge-watcher reliability and regression testing

impressions.text: The worker identified that an incomplete merge journal alone could not distinguish an active run from an interrupted one, and asked for an authoritative marker before proceeding.
The orchestrator clarified a narrowly scoped journal-mtime rule; the worker initially reported focused test failures and did not claim readiness while they remained unresolved.

The worker later reported coverage for delayed completion, missing follow-up, and one-time notification, along with passing local checks and green CI; the orchestrator confirmed the fix addressed the reported false alerts.
